notes: Compressor-cooled, water-cooled-condenser temperature test chamber (TT = no humidity system); not a cryostat: single working volume, no vacuum, no stages. Outer box 1009 x 1840 x 1340 mm (+56 mm door handle) on lockable height-adjustable castors; interior 634 x 715 x 600 mm (600 mm less 35 mm for the rear fan), 272 l, 2 perforated stainless steel shelves (max 10), 120 kg load. Entry port 80 mm diameter on the left side; left side also carries the safety thermostat, main power switch, audible alarms and Ethernet port (series page: 'Important interfaces and safety features are located on the left side of the chamber'). Temperature -75 to +180 C, stability +/-0.1 to +/-0.3 K, electric heaters in an air-treatment tunnel. Electrical 400 V 3-phase 16 A 50 Hz. Net weight approx. 540 kg. Required clearances 1000 mm rear, 500 mm lateral. Snapshots: research/v5/cache/e9d17d9a522f1385.txt (technical data), research/v5/cache/6c44c3628ffdd956.txt (series page).
